how: Many studios such as Body & Soul Yoga Club, Pure Yoga (IAPM Mall) and Hatha Yoga Boutique run beginner-to-advanced classes in English and Chinese.
A SmartShanghai listing describes PK6, a foam-pellet shooting arena in Yangpu, and an older listing mentions a paintball park in Gucun Park, Baoshan; no current proper paintball field was confirmed.
Charities such as Stepping Stones China, Shanghai Sunrise, Heart to Heart Shanghai and Shanghai Young Bakers take expat volunteers for teaching, fundraising and events.
venue: Stepping Stones China / Shanghai Sunrise (SmartShanghai list)

how: Volunteer-run Shanghai Furry Friends Rescue and Second Chance Animal Aid rescue and rehome strays and need fosters, drivers and helpers; small dog shelters also take weekday volunteers.
Shanghai Furry Friends Rescue and Second Chance Animal Aid rehome rescued stray cats and dogs locally and overseas.
A byFood-listed beer brewing workshop in Shanghai lets participants brew a batch to collect after a month; no homebrew club was found.
The Pottery Workshop on Fuxing Zhong Lu runs hand-building and wheel classes for adults in English or Chinese, and other studios offer one-off clay sessions.
Zotter Chocolate Theatre in Yangpu lets visitors craft their own chocolate bars, and the Callebaut Chocolate Academy in Huangpu runs classes mainly for professionals.
Finnish sauna evenings with a cold plunge are held by FinnCham at the FinChi Innovation Center in Zhangjiang, and Japanese-style onsen spas with Finnish saunas operate in the city.

how: FinnCham's Finnish sauna evenings in Zhangjiang include a cold plunge, but no dedicated cold-plunge venue was found.

how: Lion dance troupes such as Sanlin Dragon and Lion Dance Troupe perform at Shanghai festivals and theatres, but no public classes were found.

how: Shanghai City Symphony Orchestra is a non-profit amateur orchestra founded in 2005 that includes foreign and Chinese musicians living in Shanghai.
Geocaching.com lists past caches in Shanghai parks and a 2024 event on the Bund, but those listings are archived and the current number of active caches was not confirmed.
UDisc and PDGA list several Shanghai-area courses, including 18-hole layouts at 8090 DG Base, Pudong Red Kiln and Guangfulin Country Park in Songjiang.
venue: Guangfulin Country Park disc golf course

how: Shanghai's rules from February 2026 open free-fly zones covering about 46 percent of the urban area, plus bookable public drone experience areas at Century Park, Expo Culture Park and Botanical Garden.
venue: Shanghai Century Park drone experience area

how: The Shanghai International Aviation Competition Court in Jiading hosts model-aircraft contests and gives hobbyists space to fly, with paid admission and training courses.
Shanghai lists around 18 parks that allow kite flying, and Century Park, Zhongshan Park and Fuxing Park are popular spots with kite sellers nearby.
One-off kombucha workshops are held in Shanghai, such as a free brewing workshop at NYU Shanghai's ICA and a paid session by BASAO Kombucha in Changning in 2024.
Shanghai has dozens of VR arcades, with a 2016 TechNode count of at least 25 and sessions priced around 70 yuan for 15 minutes at venues like Machouse.
Forum posts describe Zark, a Games Workshop-stocking shop in Daning Shopping Plaza with gaming tables, and a local group of foreign 40K players, but the sources are years old.
Culturally runs a traditional Chinese woodworking workshop near Tianzifang where participants make wooden kitchen utensils with hand tools, and Zowoo at Joy City offers beginner classes.
Occasional poetry open mics are held at venues such as Cotton's on Xinhua Lu and Kartel, often tied to A Shanghai Poetry Zine launches, but no weekly slam was confirmed.
venue: A Shanghai Poetry Zine launch open mics

how: Shanghai hosts large annual cosplay-centred events such as Bilibili World and ChinaJoy, plus smaller comic conventions and the Wujiaochang ACGN Festival.
venue: Bilibili World / ChinaJoy (Shanghai New International Expo Centre)

how: Shanghai has long-standing philatelic societies including the Shanghai Philatelic Society and the Shanghai Shengxiao Philatelic Society, and hosted a large philately exhibition in early 2025.
Dedicated record shops such as Jodo Space, The Melting Pot, Vinyl Villa and Deer Music sell new and second-hand vinyl across the city.
The Hu Ronghua Bridge Club runs bridge tournaments and youth bridge education under the Shanghai Bridge Association.
Shanghai Museum of Glass in Baoshan offers hands-on glassblowing and flameworking workshops priced roughly 98-380 RMB.
